This plot is very small, only a small piece, and maize is what feeds my family. I always put a little fertilizer if I can get the coupon from the government — without that paper, the bag is too dear for me. I keep some goat droppings and old maize stalks to put in the planting holes, and I plant the seed I bought from the agro-dealer last time because my neighbor had good cobs from it. I weed with my wife and children, no money for hired hands on such a small piece.
